source.title: FIXTURE — not law: Contract Terms Fixture

heading: Reasonableness of exclusion terms
text: A term which excludes or restricts liability is effective only if the term satisfies the requirement of reasonableness. Courts consider the bargaining position of the parties.

source.title: FIXTURE — not law: Contract Terms Fixture

heading: Agreed damages
text: A provision for liquidated damages is enforceable where it is a genuine pre-estimate of the loss caused by breach. A provision that is extravagant compared with that loss is a penalty and is unenforceable.

source.title: FIXTURE — not law: Contract Terms Fixture

heading: Future provision
text: Liquidated damages penalty provisions future regime genuine pre-estimate loss enforceability.

heading: Transfer of personal data outside the country
text: An organisation must not transfer personal data outside the country unless the recipient provides a comparable standard of protection for that personal data.

heading: Old agreed damages rule
text: Liquidated damages penalty genuine pre-estimate loss enforceability contract repealed rule.

source.title: FIXTURE — not law: Malaysian Contracts Fixture

heading: Compensation for breach where penalty stipulated
text: Where a contract names a sum to be paid on breach, the party complaining of breach is entitled to reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount named.

source.title: FIXTURE — not law: Malaysian Contracts Fixture

heading: Limitation of liability
text: A term that limits or excludes liability for breach of contract is subject to review for reasonableness and liability limitation terms are construed strictly against the party relying on them.
